patterns.note: A sparse, grid-aligned layout with significant negative space creates a terminal-like interface feel, emphasizing individual content blocks.
Exclusive use of a monospaced font for all text, including navigation, headings, and body copy, reinforces a digital, code-like aesthetic.
A stark, high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates the entire site, creating a bold and minimal visual identity.
The hero section features a large, dynamic text animation composed of constantly shifting ASCII-like characters, creating a glitchy, digital art effect that is present on page load and persists.
Content sections are introduced with large, uppercase, monospaced headings aligned to a strict grid, maintaining the overall terminal interface aesthetic.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-screen canvas animation to render a large, dynamic text effect using shifting ASCII characters, creating a glitch art aesthetic.
The entire page background features a subtle, persistent scanline or static overlay effect, achieved via a canvas or CSS overlay, to enhance the retro digital screen aesthetic.
The primary navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility to key links regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely large, character-animated hero text (approx. 8-10x body text) paired with very small, uppercase monospaced body and label text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and footer areas, with content elements spread out to emphasize individual pieces of information.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-screen, constantly animating ASCII-art text effect in the hero, combined with a pervasive terminal-interface aesthetic, creates a unique and memorable digital experience that feels both retro and futuristic.
